archetypes.name: dyn-design-loads
archetypes.rationale: Rare-path prompt loads must remain adjacent to every moved branch entry.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed /design prompt surfaces for branch-local load correctness. Focus on drafter missing-row handling, Step 2b.5 retained and direct-entry paths, validator-failure entry, and settle Gate A hard-size dispatch. Verify Gate B hard-size and merged clean paths do not load the Step 2b.5 reference. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-reference-shape
archetypes.rationale: New reference files must preserve progressive-disclosure contracts without stale anchors.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new design reference files for header-triplet shape, complete moved content, and safe cross-file back-pointers. Check that moved rc handling no longer assumes `_plan_size_out` on direct-entry paths and that sentinel table usage remains maintainer-only. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
